title: Zoho CRM API: Features, Limits & ZoomInfo [July 2026]
snippet:
**Zoho CRM's** API is a mature REST surface, now on its [eighth major version](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api-directory.html), with [OAuth 2.0 authentication](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/oauth-overview.html), a credit-based rate-limit system that scales from a free tier to unlimited daily credits, [five official server-side SDKs](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/api.html), a Bulk API for asynchronous high-volume operations, a COQL query language for SQL-style record retrieval, and a Notification API for event-driven integrations.

| **Authentication** | [OAuth 2.0](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/oauth-overview.html) (authorization code grant, 1-hour access tokens, unlimited-lifetime refresh tokens) |

| **Rate limits** | [Credit-based daily pool](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/api-limits.html): 5,000/day (Free) to unlimited (Ultimate); concurrency caps of 5 to 25 simultaneous calls by edition |
| **Pricing / access** | Included on all plans, including Free (3 users, 5,000 credits/day); no separate API tier |

API access starts with any **Zoho CRM** account, including the [permanent free plan](https://www.zoho.com/crm/zohocrm-pricing.html) (up to 3 users, 5,000 API credits per day).
There is no separate developer signup, no enterprise gate, and no approval process. Zoho also offers a [free Developer Edition](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/developer-edition.html), a full CRM instance for building and testing integrations without affecting production data.

- [**Developer Edition**](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/developer-edition.html)**:** A free CRM instance for developers building third-party integrations.

## Add-on Credits
If your organization requires more API credits than the allowed limit for your edition, write to [support@zohocrm.com](mailto:support@zohocrm.com) and purchase additional credits.
The below table gives the pricing details for different credit slabs.
| Add-on Credits per 24 hours | Price in $ per 1000 Credits |

**Note**
- If you choose to purchase 25,000 add-on credits, the price will be (25,000 x $0.14)/1000 = $3.5. The price per month will be $3.5 x 30 = $105. Similarly, if you want to purchase 75,000 credits, the price will be (25,000 x 0.14)/1000+(50,000 x 0.06)/1000 = $6.5, and the price per month will be $6.5 x 30 = $195.
- If you want to purchase 100,000 credits, then you will be charged a total of $240 per month ($105 for 25000 + $135 for 75,000).
- You can purchase either a maximum of 500,000 extra credits, or the difference between your edition's maximum credit limit and your current API limit, whichever is lower.

title: aiproductivity.ai/guides/zoho-crm-api-developer-guide
snippet:
A Zoho developer account is just a regular Zoho account with the API Console activated. Sign in at the [API console](https://api-console.zoho.com/) (swapping the TLD for your data center) using the same credentials you use for the CRM web app. The console is where you will create OAuth clients, view scopes, and generate self-client codes.

API access is included from Standard ($14/month annual per user annual) and above; the Free plan has limited or no API access. If you are evaluating Zoho CRM specifically because of the API, start a paid trial rather than the Free tier. The Free plan supports up to 3 users and basic CRUD in the UI, but it does not give developers a stable API surface to build against. For a full breakdown of what each tier unlocks for API work, see the [Zoho CRM pricing page](/go/zoho-crm/?p=%2Fcrm%2Fpricing).

### Is Zoho CRM API free?
API access is included from the Standard plan ($14/month annual per user annual) and above. The Free plan, which supports up to 3 users, has limited or no API access and is not recommended for serious integration work. Advanced API features such as Zia AI predictions and sentiment analysis require the Enterprise plan ($40/month annual per user annual) or Ultimate ($52/month annual per user annual). Developers should start with a paid trial rather than the Free plan when evaluating API capabilities.

Zoho CRM uses OAuth. The steps below follow Zoho CRM's own docs.
1.  Create a Zoho CRM account. API access starts on the Standard plan.
2.  Register a client in the Zoho API console, get a grant code, exchange it for an access token (expires\_in 3600 s) and a refresh token; tokens are org-specific and data-centre-specific. Accounts URLs: US accounts.zoho.com, AU.com.au, EU.eu, IN.in, CN.com.cn, JP.jp, SA accounts.zoho.sa, CA accounts.zohocloud.ca; API domain follows the DC (e.g. www.zohoapis.eu, www.zohoapis.com.cn).
3.  Send it with every request: header: Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <access\_token>.
4.  Make a first call: Insert or update up to 100 records, matched on duplicate check fields (system unique fields or fields marked unique), order set by duplicate\_check\_fields. Keep the key in an environment variable, never in the command.

title: FAQs on Developer Space
snippet:
You can use the Zoho CRM REST API to retrieve data from the Leads module and other modules. Refer to [this](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v2/modules-api.html) document for more details.

## If I am using the Enterprise Edition, and I have subscribed for 2 additional users, how many API requests can I make per day?
In Zoho CRM, a single Enterprise Edition user can make a maximum of 25,000 requests per day per organization or 500 users per user license, whichever is lower.
The minimum and maximum limits vary according to the edition which the organization is currently using.

If the present API limit does not meet your business requirement, you can increase the API limit/day. To know more about the pricing details to increase the API call limits, please send an email to [support@zohocrm.com](mailto:support@zohocrm.com)

## Can I increase the API limit?
Yes. If the present API limit does not meet your business requirements, you can increase your API limit/day. All you need to do is send us an email to [support@zohocrm.com](mailto:support@zohocrm.com) with your requirements and we will get back to you with the pricing details to increase the API call limits.

## Can everyone in a company use the same API Key?
Yes, everyone in your company can use the same API key for development and integration of third-party applications.

## If I am in the Free Edition, how many API requests can I make per day?
In the Free Edition, you can make a maximum of 1000 requests/day/organization.

title: Zoho Developer API | Developer Help - Zoho CRM
snippet:
To use the Vertical Solution API, you'll require the ** Authentication Token** from your CRM account. Please make sure that you have the permission to access the API service. If you do not have permission, please contact your CRM administrator.
## API Limit
The API limits for vertical solutions are as given below:
- Min - **4000** requests/day/organization
- Max - **25000** requests/day/organization or 500 requests /user license whichever is lower
#### Important Notes
- The PST Time zone will be considered.
- We notify CRM administrators (Users with "Administrator" profile) if your organization exceeds the API limit. We also provide API Statistics for better assessment of your integration requirements.
- To optimize your API usage, get maximum **200 records** with each request and insert, update or delete maximum **100 records** with each request.
*Example*: If you have purchased 10 user licenses, you are allowed 2500 requests per day. Using each of those 2500 requests, you can update maximum 100 records. **That would be 2500 x 100 i.e. 250,000 records can be updated/inserted/deleted per day**.
- In case, your application requires more than the upper limit, your additional API requests will not be processed. To avoid data transfer issues, please assess your API requirements well in advance. If you need any help, please contact our Support at **support@zohocrm.com**
## Check API Request Usage
You can view the total limit for API calls and the current day's API usage in your vertical solution.
1. Go to **Setup** > **Developer** **Space** > **APIs**.
2. In the CRM API page, the **Usage** section lists the per day usage and total limit for the API calls.
